failed_or_abandoned: First run: boolean-index mismatch when comparing the 267-point spectrum grid with P021's 113-point cache (fixed by comparing on P021's grid).
Second run: OverflowError rounding an infinite edge value (NR-band MSSI never reaches 0.1 events below 1700 phd); fixed.
Seeding nestpy's internal generator was not attempted through NESTcalc; run-to-run scatter of E50 is 0.2 keV and is quoted.
A 2D (S1c, log S2c) likelihood per edge was judged unnecessary: the S1c cut acts on the S1c marginal and the S2c ceiling is irrelevant below ~1200 phd.
400/4000 GeV, O1 isovector and O4 spectra not rerun (mechanism operator- and mass-independent for a given recoil window; P021 covers the peaks).
